title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
plot_overview: Following the highly publicized death of a whistleblower, an investigation examines a once-iconic aviation giant amid a deepening corporate crisis. Insider accounts and startling new revelations shed light on the company’s troubles and the questions surrounding its handling of serious concerns.
will_you_like_this: You may like this if you enjoy urgent corporate investigations and revealing documentary accounts; Not for you if you prefer character-driven stories or lighter viewing.
review_summary: Pros: timely subject; insider perspectives; investigative focus | Cons: potentially one-sided; heavy subject matter
